payload.summary: Planned a provider-adapter boundary for retrieval with write, search, read, and improve actions over content chunks and agent memories. Decided on protocol extraction with a composition layer (Approach 1): Postgres adapter with a parity golden test, LanceDB as the flagged secondary with fail-safe dual-write and post-response shadow read, and retrieval metrics added to aca evaluate. Tier: coordinated. Gate 1 approved Approach 1 with no modifications.

decisions.title: Adapters return per-leg candidates; fusion, rerank, and tree search live above them
decisions.rationale: Keeps one RRF implementation for both namespaces and makes shadow comparisons attributable per leg.

decisions.title: Write means index write; system-of-record row inserts stay in the ORM
decisions.rationale: document_chunks ids are database-assigned and referenced by content_references; the adapter owns embedding and provenance writes only.

decisions.title: No delete verb: replace_parent on write plus orphan reconciliation in improve
decisions.rationale: Preserves the four-action contract while covering reindex and content deletion.

decisions.title: LanceDB is the second adapter; Infino and turbopuffer are documented future adapters
decisions.rationale: LanceDB exercises every protocol seam with a mature API; Infino is 0.x with Enterprise-only lakehouse integration; turbopuffer is hosted-only.

decisions.title: Retrieval metrics extend aca evaluate via a retrieval dataset kind and reuse evaluation_results
decisions.rationale: Avoids a parallel evaluation surface and keeps report generation working; additive nullable migration limits overlap with the routing work.

decisions.title: Every retrieval setting defaults off; secondary adapter and shadow read are opt-in
decisions.rationale: Rollback is unsetting settings; production evidence relying on meta.bm25_strategy stays valid.

next_steps: Start with wp-contracts (tasks 1.1-1.7); record the parity baseline (2.1) before any refactor touches search.py.
Coordinate with operationalize-llm-evaluation-routing before wp-evaluation begins.
